scope.execution_policy: Coverage obligations are not executable scenarios. A broad identity predicate alone never admits an action. An authored scenario must supply and verify all required native subcontext, target, eligibility, outcome and exit guards before execution; unresolved identity fields stay blocked for that scenario.
scope.description: A bounded starting denominator for state-aware bot cases and later control teaching material. Each listed variant must be audited independently; this inventory does not assert that every native mode has been discovered.

binding_export.configuration: No user configuration file was passed; the executable exported current default effective bindings. Resolve listed IDs against each run's effective export so custom/disabled bindings are respected.
binding_export.warning: These eight coarse resolver categories are input dispatch contexts, not a complete list of native game modes or interaction states. CONTROL_SCHEMA.json is human-authored guidance, not runtime proof.

scope.verification_limit: The September 26 prototype has bounded observations for Continue, Pause open/close, iDroid open and one tutorial acknowledgment, plus a recorded posture failure. No full-context or physical-headset pass is claimed.

status_vocabulary.identity_predicate_format: predicate is null when no executable observation predicate is currently supported. Otherwise, all is a set of strict dot-path equals checks against the bot observation (all must match), and any is a list of strict equals-check sets where at least one set must match. Missing/stale fields fail the case. These are obligation predicates; native-only fields require the optional Lua scenario snapshot and must be added to the bot case explicitly.

binding_status.implemented: The referenced semantic action/axis exists in the current source export; this does not certify that its dispatch context matches the native situation.
binding_status.partial: Some required inputs exist, while an input path is disabled, absent, or only covers a subset of the obligation.
binding_status.unknown: The current source and export do not establish a usable route.

identity_status.available_in_current_telemetry: The listed predicate uses fields exposed by the current fast bot observer; unlisted subcontext fields can still be missing.
identity_status.partial: Only a broad scene/status cue or optional Lua snapshot is available; it does not uniquely identify the native subcontext.
identity_status.unknown: No current predicate can identify this native subcontext.

native_outcome_status.verified_bounded: A bounded native transition was observed in the September 26 prototype; it is not a complete context pass.
native_outcome_status.partial_observation: Some native response was observed, with required substate or return behavior still open.
native_outcome_status.observed_failure: An attempted action failed its native state predicate in the recorded prototype run.
native_outcome_status.unverified: No matching end-to-end outcome was verified for the current prototype.
native_outcome_status.unknown: No meaningful native identity or outcome is exposed by the current telemetry.

instrumentation_gaps.missing: Exact focused menu item, enabled native choices, nested menu owner, and tutorial/acknowledgment mask.
instrumentation_gaps.available: The fast observer exposes title/menu/iDroid open flags; it does not expose focus or selected option.

instrumentation_gaps.missing: Fresh mounted/seat/emplacement role, on-foot subcontext, aim/weapon readiness, cover/hide, target eligibility, and action acceptance in one correlated native observation.
instrumentation_gaps.available: The optional Lua scenario query records mission/sequence, selected player status bits, buddy and a few weapon slots; the fast control audit records one coarse resolver category and sampled inputs.

instrumentation_gaps.missing: Target identity/range/eligibility, prompt kind, current CQC/hold-up/interrogation option, and resulting intel or target-state delta.
instrumentation_gaps.available: No target-action contract is published in the bot snapshot; native script source describes dispatch paths but not current scene eligibility.

instrumentation_gaps.missing: Interactive versus noninteractive demo class, camera-cut generation, per-step input lock, permitted skip/cancel, and re-acquired player control.
instrumentation_gaps.available: The current scene classifier sees one demo boolean and labels it cinematic.

instrumentation_gaps.missing: Selected native equipment ID/grade, availability reason, effect-specific state delta, and item-specific cancel behavior across all owned eligible IDs.
instrumentation_gaps.available: The fast snapshot does not enumerate the full native equipment catalog or validate item effects.

instrumentation_gaps.missing: Native helicopter passenger/seat/weapon role, vehicle subtype, mount identity, control handoff, and exit readiness.
instrumentation_gaps.available: The scenario query reports sequence and player statuses but does not publish native helicopter or emplacement role identity.

instrumentation_gaps.missing: Game-consumed action result, rejection reason, and matching visible native effect.
instrumentation_gaps.available: Input sampling and XR-published gamepad bits establish delivery only; they do not establish game acceptance.

records.context: Title helicopter cabin, Continue cassette/rack focus, physical interaction, title exit and saved-game handoff.

required_actions.intent: Enter and traverse the real cabin; identify the Continue cassette by native focus/prompt before interacting.
required_actions.outcome: Visible intended Continue selection is proven before input.

required_actions.intent: Squeeze the right-hand controller Trigger once at the verified physical rack target; do not use a blind menu confirm.
required_actions.outcome: One native title-to-loading transition.

required_actions.intent: Wait for the actual Resume/confirm phase when the native loader requests it.
required_actions.outcome: Loading completes and the expected saved gameplay session is observed.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Abort on changed scene/focus or missing native rack; never send a guessed back/confirm action or repeat an ambiguous input. Neutralize and record the safe stop.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Neutral input and a recorded safe stop or one verified gameplay arrival.

records.context: Mission selection, deployment/loadout, sortie preparation, launch and return-to-ACC transitions.

required_actions.intent: Enumerate the visible native menu choices and select an eligible mission/loadout without assuming catalog options.
required_actions.outcome: Selected sortie identity, gear and actual mission launch are independently observed.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Exercise native back/cancel at each preparation layer and verify whether it returns to the previous menu, ACC or gameplay.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Known prior state restored; no menu-focus guess.

records.context: Snake boards support helicopter, rides/transports, lands or exits, and returns control to field play.

required_actions.intent: Observe a native boarding prompt, board once, follow the transport phase, and verify field-control handoff after landing/exiting.
required_actions.outcome: Correct passenger role, camera, native transition and post-transport player control are observed.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Record each native exit/landing/cancel path exposed in the actual helicopter state; do not assume a generic vehicle exit.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Native helicopter state ends and Snake's expected gameplay mode is restored.

records.context: Pause open, native navigation/options, allowed actions across camera cuts, close and return.

required_actions.intent: Open Pause and verify its native open flag and both-eye menu pixels.
required_actions.outcome: menu=true, idroid=false and visible Pause UI.

required_actions.intent: Navigate one native menu item and change an eligible option only in a declared test case.
required_actions.outcome: Native focus and selected value change are observed; disabled default D-pad actions are reported as unavailable.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Close Pause with native back and verify gameplay camera/input ownership returns.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: menu=false and live gameplay presentation resumes.

records.context: iDroid open, map pan/zoom, native tabs/submenus and safe close/reopen.

required_actions.intent: Open the iDroid and verify the native screen and its tracked/handheld presentation.
required_actions.outcome: idroid=true and visible native iDroid UI.

required_actions.intent: Pan/zoom the map and visit available tabs; do not treat UI input delivery as a selected-map result.
required_actions.outcome: Map/tabs visibly change and selected item is recorded.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use the observed native back path, then verify gameplay; reopen once only after close is confirmed.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: idroid=false with gameplay active; any nested tutorial acknowledgment is handled as its own state.

records.context: Nested iDroid/Mother Base tutorial acknowledgment, D-pad navigation, escape, gameplay return and reopen.

missing: tutorial mask and current tutorial page
whether B/back is safe in each page

required_actions.intent: Discover each required native tutorial response from its visible prompt; never synthesize a choice from remembered layouts.
required_actions.outcome: Tutorial progression/acknowledgment is native and visible.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Verify a safe escape, gameplay resume, then reopen the iDroid without leaving a held pause/tutorial state.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Fresh gameplay observation and a successful second open/close cycle.

records.context: Radio/cassette playback and native text/voice overlays while field gameplay continues or pauses.

missing: whether the active mission owns the input

required_actions.intent: Exercise available cassette/radio selection and playback only after the native screen/choice is identified.
required_actions.outcome: Correct native track/message begins and input ownership is understood.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use the visible native close/back action and verify gameplay input resumes.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Overlay ends and ordinary play resumes.

records.context: On-foot standing, squat/crouch, crawl/prone, movement, sprint, dive/roll and transitions among stances.

missing: continuous fresh stance/body state in the fast observer

required_actions.intent: For each native stance, verify enter, hold, movement, turn, exit and repeat transitions separately.
required_actions.outcome: Native status changes to the requested posture and player/camera remain aligned.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Return to a known stance with a fresh native state check; neutralize controls after a timeout.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Requested status is observed; failed action is recorded without counting input delivery as success.

records.context: On-foot weapon ready/stow, aim, fire, scope zoom, reload, switch and weapon-specific attachments across eligible IDs.

missing: current weapon ID/grade and native ready/aim state in the fast observer

required_actions.intent: Enumerate each owned eligible weapon and attachment independently; ready, aim, fire only at an eligible target, reload, change weapon and verify state deltas.
required_actions.outcome: Correct weapon/action, ammunition and native/visible result are observed; obstruction remains native.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Stow by releasing weapon-ready input; stop firing on scene or ownership changes.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Weapon is native-stowed and input is neutral.

records.context: Contextual cover/lean, cardboard box and toilet hiding, enter/leave and re-acquire field view.

missing: native hiding/cover mode and exact hideable target

required_actions.intent: Approach one eligible cover/hide object, use the actual prompt, observe native hide/cover state, and test view/control without assuming all surfaces share a route.
required_actions.outcome: Correct hide/cover state enters and camera remains aligned.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use the native exit route for that object, then verify on-foot posture and movement.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Hide state clears and field control returns.

records.context: Native traversal interactions such as climb, ladder, vault, dive and local obstacle crossing.

required_actions.intent: Create one case per native traversal prompt/edge and verify the destination, floor and player status; no timed input counts as arrival.
required_actions.outcome: Native transition completes at the expected supported destination.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use only an observed cancel/withdraw path where available and record an unrecoverable edge as blocked.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Known source state restored or explicit blocked result.

records.context: Context pickups including plants, diamonds, cassettes and dropped weapons; preserve item-specific native prompt and result.

required_actions.intent: For each object class, read the actual prompt, perform its native context or hold action once, and check the inventory/collection delta.
required_actions.outcome: Expected native item is acquired exactly once.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Release held input and leave the prompt range; verify no duplicate pickup or stuck carry state.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Input neutral and inventory result stable.

records.context: Fulton launch/recovery for each eligible restrained person, animal, vehicle or cargo class, including campaign restrictions.

missing: target class/eligibility and extraction success ratio

required_actions.intent: Probe eligibility per target class, use the visible native prompt, and verify launch plus mission/recovery result without treating input delivery as extraction.
required_actions.outcome: Target is accepted and the expected native recovery state/result occurs.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use the current prompt's native cancel path if launch has not begun; after launch, observe the irreversible outcome before any retry.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: One confirmed extraction or a recorded eligibility/rejection result.

records.context: Contextual CQC attack/grab, hold-up, restraint and release/stun/death outcomes on eligible targets.

references: docs/SYSTEMS_ACCESS.md::Ordinary CQC and Physical melee contract

required_actions.intent: Approach a legal target state, use the contextual native CQC route, and verify the exact attack/grab/restraint response before continuing.
required_actions.outcome: Native target status/reaction matches the intended contextual action.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Release attack input; use a target-specific release/setdown route only when the current native prompt establishes it.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: No held button remains and target state is known.

records.context: Eligible restrained guard interrogation, dynamically available native responses/orders and resulting intel/map updates.

missing: native option list and enabled choice

required_actions.intent: Discover choices from the current native interrogation prompt, then determine its matching input route from the prompt and current effective export. No buddy-Commands route or fixed response is assumed. Correlate the result with voice, target and intel/map state.
required_actions.outcome: The target acknowledges the selected response and the expected native reveal/order result is visible and observed.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use the option presented by the current native interaction to end/release; verify the guard and player are no longer in the interrogation state.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Interaction ends cleanly and gameplay resumes.

records.context: Pick up/carry restrained people or objects, move while carrying, set down/release, and return to ordinary posture.

required_actions.intent: Use a visible eligible pickup/carry prompt, move a bounded route, and verify native carried state and target association.
required_actions.outcome: Native carry status and target follow behavior are observed.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use the current target's native setdown/release action and verify status_CARRY clears.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Target is safely set down/released; Snake returns to a known on-foot state.

records.context: Wrist picker open, primary/secondary/support/item categories, browse, back, selection and explicit Use prompts.

required_actions.intent: Open while verifying the native overview, center between choices, browse each available category/card, and confirm only an eligible visible selection.
required_actions.outcome: Native selected ID/slot changes to the intended available item; explicit Use produces its own result.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use native back or release the picker modifier as appropriate; verify normal play and controls context return.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Picker closes with a known selected item and no held input.

records.context: Each owned, mission-eligible equipment ID/grade and its primary, secondary, support or item-specific effects/alternate controls.

required_actions.intent: Generate one case per owned eligible item ID/grade, execute its native primary/alternate/use path, and verify its documented effect and recovery. Do not count selection as execution.
required_actions.outcome: Item-specific native world/state delta is verified and tied to the exact ID/config export.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use item-specific stow, cancel or safe native timeout and confirm selected/equipped state; avoid retry after an ambiguous one-shot use.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Known item state and no duplicate use.

records.context: Raise/stow binoculars, zoom, run/stance, native target marking/unmarking, intel/analysis and waypoint behavior.

missing: native binocular state and eye alignment

required_actions.intent: Equip, compare both-eye world/optic view, zoom, acquire/unmark one eligible visible target, and check native map/intel progression separately.
required_actions.outcome: Native optic state, target mark, analysis and visible result are separately established.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Stow with the explicit binocular action and verify surrounding scene, weapon state and gameplay dispatch return.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Optic is stowed and gameplay resumes.

records.context: Weapon-authored scope/optic per weapon ID, eye relief, magnification inputs and restoration to ordinary aim.

required_actions.intent: Test each scoped weapon independently at supported eye distances and its authored magnification; do not infer scope behavior from binocular zoom or another rifle.
required_actions.outcome: Correct weapon scope view/zoom and shot alignment are visible in both eyes.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Lower/stow weapon and verify optic scene closes without changing the selected weapon unexpectedly.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Normal stereo world and native selected weapon restored.

records.context: On-foot Call/Commands menu; choices differ by active buddy, ability, progression and current native situation.

required_actions.intent: Open only when the observed native menu is available, read current choices, select one available order and verify the buddy response.
required_actions.outcome: Correct active buddy/ability acknowledges the native order.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use native back or release the open modifier, then verify gameplay input ownership resumes.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Commands closes and no stick input leaks into movement/camera.

records.context: D-Horse prompt/mount, rider locomotion/turn/speed, weapon/actions and dismount; mounted buddy Commands are a separate role.

required_actions.intent: At a real D-Horse prompt, mount; verify mounted status, ride/steer/speed, lower weapon as needed and repeat through dismount.
required_actions.outcome: Native horse/rider motion, camera and player root agree in both travel directions.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use the observed dismount route and verify return to the original on-foot stance/camera owner.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Native horse mount state clears and ordinary gameplay dispatch returns.

records.context: D-Horse mounted Call/Commands choices, including command-specific hold modifiers, while preserving rider control.

required_actions.intent: Open with the mounted chord and keep the required modifier held only for the menu lifetime; identify and select an available order.
required_actions.outcome: Native buddy order occurs without confusing the chord with gallop or steering.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Close/back out, release modifier and confirm rider movement remains available.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Commands context clears and horse route remains active.

records.context: Driver seat in each tested light truck/jeep/ordinary wheeled vehicle subtype; each native subtype is an independent case.

required_actions.intent: For each named subtype, enter, steer both directions, accelerate, brake/reverse, test permitted weapon/call controls and observe real displacement.
required_actions.outcome: Vehicle-specific motion and input role are verified; an entry in one vehicle does not pass another.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use the vehicle's native exit prompt and verify on-foot placement, view and control context.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Native seat clears and on-foot control resumes.

records.context: Driver/control station for each supported tracked tank and APC class, including distinct camera, movement and exit behavior.

required_actions.intent: Create distinct tank and APC cases; enter, move, steer, brake and test each available station/weapon route independently.
required_actions.outcome: Subtype-specific view, movement, station ownership and intended native effect are observed.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Exit using the native station route; confirm correct on-foot state and no inherited camera offset.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Vehicle role ends and ordinary gameplay resumes.

records.context: ZHUK RS-ZO combat vehicle weapon station, aiming/elevation/range selection and rocket impact.

required_actions.intent: Enter this weapon station as its own native mode, aim, adjust the authored range where available, fire once and verify impact.
required_actions.outcome: Range and aim correspond to the intended visible target and rocket impact.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use native exit and verify station/camera return.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: On-foot/player state is restored.

records.context: Each native machine-gun turret emplacement: access, view, traverse/elevation, reticle, fire and exit.

required_actions.intent: For each emplacement instance/class, enter, aim on both axes, confirm visible reticle, fire at a safe target and verify result.
required_actions.outcome: Aim, elevation, reticle and native firing outcome match the selected emplacement.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use the emplacement's native exit and check field camera/input ownership.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Mounted weapon role clears and gameplay resumes.

records.context: Each native mortar emplacement: access, reticle, range/aim, fire, impact and exit.

required_actions.intent: Enter one mortar, establish its native targeting/range behavior, fire at a safe visible target and verify impact independently of machine-gun turrets.
required_actions.outcome: Intended targeting/range results in a visible native impact.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use the native mortar exit and verify return to the correct gameplay mode.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Mortar role ends and player control resumes.

records.context: D-Walker/Walker Gear pilot state, movement, weapon/alternate modes, camera transition and exit.

missing: active mount versus merely obtained buddy
D-Walker native mode and current effect

required_actions.outcome: Native D-Walker motion/effect and camera are confirmed for the active unlocked configuration.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use native dismount/exit, then verify Snake's on-foot status and camera ownership.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: D-Walker mode ends and on-foot play resumes.

records.context: Noninteractive multi-shot cinematic, including camera cuts, full-body/avatar presentation, Pause policy and return to play.

missing: native input lock and allowed skip

required_actions.intent: Observe the full native cinematic through each camera cut; attempt only controls permitted by the live native prompt and inspect both eyes/avatar presentation.
required_actions.outcome: Camera/body remain valid across cuts; permitted Pause/navigation/skip visibly works and returns to play.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Honor the sequence's native completion or explicitly offered skip only; verify player camera and gameplay dispatch are reacquired.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Native demo clears and expected player state returns.

records.context: Interactive first-playthrough demo/tutorial that suspends for a required player input, including Mission 1 Ocelot binocular lesson.

missing: specific expected input and tutorial page

required_actions.outcome: The requested tutorial step advances and its native completion/progression state is observed.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Use only the currently displayed tutorial skip/cancel/acknowledgment control when offered; preserve first-playthrough completion path.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Tutorial exits through native rules and gameplay returns without skipping required progression.

records.context: Scripted in-game camera/player transition, voice-triggered checkpoint, cut to/from gameplay and control restoration; Mission 6 bridge is a named independent case.

missing: specific native event/trigger and mission/sequence value
input remap and actor root before/after

exit_or_cancel.intent: Follow the native checkpoint/transition recovery if movement remains locked; do not inject guessed movement through a cinematic lock.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Known gameplay or known recovery checkpoint is reached and logged.

records.context: Skull Face jeep ride sequence: seated/player body, cinematic camera changes, any prompted input and exit to gameplay.

exit_or_cancel.intent: Wait for native sequence completion or use an explicit offered skip, then verify gameplay camera and controls resume.
exit_or_cancel.outcome: Expected next mission/gameplay state and control owner are confirmed.

required_actions.outcome: Result reason and selected next state are confirmed; camera/player mode matches on-foot or mounted source.

native action result and GZ-specific presentation state

guide_and_bot_use: The bot should turn every record into state-predicated cases with action, native outcome, and exit checks. A tutorial/field-kit clip can be generated only from a case whose effective binding export and current native outcome evidence are joined; this inventory itself is not a completed guide or film.
